title: Habitable rooms have openings on at least two walls, centres at least 2 m apart in a straight line
text: Habitable rooms have openings on at least two walls with a straight line distance between the centre of the openings of at least 2m.

replaces.note: identical text; the ToC claim that it now reads 'openings (windows and/or doors)' is not in the draft (C4P2-111)

notes: verify: read literally the clause applies to every habitable room, which few single-aspect apartments could meet; it may be meant per dwelling (openings to two walls of the dwelling). dwellings.min.openings_two_walls is read as every habitable room (FACTS-PROPOSED-part4a.md). New 2 m figure is labelled Figure 4.1c (figures in 4.2 are copies of 4.1 numbering).

verified.note: Page prints "Habitable rooms have openings on at least two walls" for every habitable room; read literally few single-aspect apartments could comply. Drafting ambiguity (per room or per dwelling) left for review.
